name: netcafe
description: Deterministic tools for messy real-world data: bank reconciliation without a shared key, Excel that keeps leading zeros and real dates, duplicate-company detection, US HS/HTS codes, and mainland-China reachability. No API key needed to start.

interface.shortDescription: Deterministic tools for reconciliation, Excel, entity dedupe, HS codes, and China reachability.
interface.longDescription: Hosted deterministic tools with no model call inside: reconcile a bank statement against a ledger with no shared reference number, read and write .xlsx without losing leading zeros or turning dates into serial numbers, find duplicate companies via tax-ID checksums, verify US HS/HTS tariff codes, and measure whether a site is reachable from mainland China. Every result involving counts or money carries an arithmetic self-check computed in code. No API key needed to start.
